name: My Hours
description: My Hours is time-tracking and workforce-management software for teams and independent professionals. Businesses use it to record billable and non-billable work, organize clients, projects, and tasks, run timers and timesheets, manage people and approvals, control budgets and rates, and produce operational and billing reports.
agentUseSummary: Create a My Hours API key on a paid plan, add it once, then choose which agents can read or manage the connected user's authorized time, work, reporting, client, tag, and team data under Safe or Dangerous policy.

credentialRequirements.label: My Hours API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: In My Hours, open Settings, Integrations, API keys and create a dedicated key. API keys require a paid plan, inherit the creating user's permissions, and are encrypted by Relay.

capabilities.label: Read time, work, reports, and people
capabilities.description: Use all 13 pinned semantic reads for time logs, projects, tasks, assignments, reports, clients, tags, users, and teams.

capabilities.label: Manage time, work, and people
capabilities.description: Use all 22 pinned mutations to create, edit, archive, copy, assign, tag, start, stop, or delete authorized records.

allowed.label: Read My Hours
allowed.description: Run one exact selected semantic read from My Hours API v1.1.

approvalRequired.label: Manage My Hours
approvalRequired.description: Run one exact selected My Hours mutation; Safe mode requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: All 13 semantic reads run directly; every mutation requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: All 35 selected and API-key-authorized operations run without Relay per-action approval; connection ownership, My Hours user permissions, paid-plan access, exact routes, bounds, audits, redaction, and provider limits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts all 35 unique operations from the official My Hours API v1.1 collection through the encrypted customer-key connector.

providerSetup.blocker: No customer-owned paid My Hours account, user-bound API key, or representative permission set is available in this workspace.
providerSetup.nextAction: A My Hours user on a paid plan creates a dedicated API key under Settings, Integrations, saves it through Relay Console, then verifies user and project authority, all unique operations, semantic Safe reads, Safe approvals, Dangerous mutations, timers, reports, credential replacement, agent assignment, disconnect, revocation, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: My Hours' official help guide says API keys are available on paid plans, are created under Settings and Integrations, are bound to the user who creates them, and can be deleted to revoke access.

My Hours' official API v1.1 collection documents Authorization: ApiKey authentication and 36 request examples across time logs, projects, tasks, assignments, reports, clients, tags, users, and teams; one GET /Tags example is duplicated, yielding 35 unique operations.
My Hours describes its time tracking, timesheets, projects, tasks, budgets, rates, reporting, approvals, people management, billing, and API integration features.
My Hours' current terms identify the service as an online subscription product operated by SPICA and describe customer data, permissions, security, and subscription responsibilities.
